title: Jingle Bells
source: Published 1857 as "One Horse Open Sleigh" (Boston); James Lord Pierpont died 1893. Pierpont's own verses in their 1857 wording ("O'er the hills", "Oh what sport", "what joy it is to ride", "we, we got upsot"), not the 1859 and later changes.
